subject: Billing runway: PO header enforcement, invoice cadence, and tiered-credit eligibility

Cc: procurement@clearforge.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Billing window & PO header requirements

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement flagged a couple of must-haves for us to move forward on PO issuance:

- The PO must contain a Billing Entity line (legal entity name + remit address) and an internal BU code field.
- Net terms on supplier invoices are standardly Net45; finance will accept Net60 only with a senior approval and a supporting justification.
- Invoices should be consolidated monthly per legal entity. If Redwood must invoice per subscription or service instance, we need a mapping table in the PO.
- For discounts tied to committed usage (tiered credits), the commitment must be documented in an SOW or an attached schedule; procurement will not accept retroactive credits without the schedule on file.

I attached our PO template for your ops team. Our CFO also asked whether you can offer an early-pay discount (1.5–2%) for Net45 vs Net60 — is that something Redwood can consider?

Best,
Maggie O'Hara
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearForge Analytics

Attachment: ClearForge_PO_Template_2027.pdf (application/pdf)

Maggie — thanks for the clear list and the template. Looping in Vanessa (Finance partnerships) and Marissa (Customer Ops) to confirm what we can accept out of the box and what needs legal/finance approval.

Quick answers / clarifying questions from our side:
1) Billing entity & BU code — we can populate both on our invoices. We also support a PO field called "billing_reference" which can carry arbitrary customer mapping keys. Will that work?
2) Net terms — our standard is Net30 for self-serve, and Net45/Net60 are both supported for enterprise. We can accept Net45 without escalation; Net60 typically requires an account-level exception. For an early-pay discount we can engage a pricing exception.
3) Invoice cadence — we prefer consolidated monthly invoices per legal entity; we can produce per-entity monthly statements. If ClearForge requires per-subscription invoices, we will need to attach a mapping CSV each month.
4) Tiered credits — we'll need the commitment schedule in writing. We can attach a billing schedule to the contract and include automated crediting per threshold.

Action items proposed:
- Vanessa, please confirm finance stance on 2% early-pay credit for Net45 vs Net60 for this deal (DF-8791).
- Marissa, confirm attachment options for the mapping table and whether we can auto-ingest the PO template fields.
- Maggie, if procurement can accept monthly consolidated billing by legal entity and include BU codes on the PO, we should be able to proceed with a standard commitment schedule.

I'll also attach our current quote (v3) with the tiered credit table for reference.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
